messages.security.plugin.trust.allowUnsandboxed.h: Off by default. When your system can isolate a plugin and the attempt fails, the plugin does not start — turning this on lets it run with your full access instead, and its row will say "not sandboxed". It has no effect where the system cannot isolate plugins at all.
